app_info.description: Browse county property records, group parcels by recorded owner name, and compare three Hamilton County lead packages. Preview records, save a search, and review the price and terms for one package or monthly updates before checkout. Your GISDB account shows payment, subscription and CSV delivery status. Prices and included records depend on the available offer. Weekly checks may find no new records. Added notice, delinquency and municipal data, CAD exports, and estimates of selling motivation are unavailable.
app_info.subtitle: County property records and Hamilton lead packages

positive_test_cases.description: Test Case 1: County property record search
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Returns available Hamilton County records with their source dates and limitations. Leaves missing facts unknown and makes no claim about willingness to sell.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Browse Hamilton County, TN property records and show the source and limitations.

positive_test_cases.description: Test Case 2: Save property search criteria
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Saves the selected search under the connected GISDB account. Shows any returned recurring offer and its terms without starting a purchase or subscription.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Help me save a property search and explain any available recurring offer before I decide.

positive_test_cases.expected_output: Lists returned county records products and source dates. Explains that a directory entry does not mean a package is available to buy.

positive_test_cases.description: Test Case 5: County dataset metadata inspection
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Shows the returned Hamilton County dataset details, source links, dates and missing facts. Does not infer a current tax year or CAD compatibility.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Inspect the Hamilton County dataset metadata and show official citations using GISDB.

Saving searches and reviewing orders require a dedicated GISDB reviewer account with the stated permissions. Purchase cases require an authorized test environment and a reviewed offer. Provide reviewer access through secure dashboard fields; do not put credentials in this package.
